sourceRefs.locator: Letter 46, pp. 75–76, especially p. 75 from Igitur qui celeber est natalis and p. 76 on the liberated captives. Avitus acknowledges his absence from the ceremony.
pp. 29–31, 47–49 and 55–56. The traditional 496 chronology, the proposed identification of Avitus’s captives and the argument for Christmas 508.

summary.de: Der Gratulationsbrief verbindet die Geburt Christi mit der Taufe des Königs. Er enthält keine Jahresangabe.
summary.en: The congratulatory letter links the Nativity with the king’s baptism and gives no year.
